verdict.rationale: LangSmith offers background automation primarily around monitoring/evaluation: automated rules, webhooks, online evaluators that run continuously on production traces, threshold-based alerts routed to Slack/PagerDuty, and an 'Engine' that automatically detects and resolves recurring issues. These are genuine autonomous background processes, but they are scoped to observability/eval workflows rather than general-purpose agent task automation, and evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent confirmation of reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these automations working reliably in production, more detail on rule/webhook configuration flexibility, and evidence of broader autonomous agentic workflows beyond monitoring.
